culprit_citations.quoted_text: Term Loan | First Lien | 3M SOFR+ 6.50 % | Cash 11.10 % | Cost $ 1,750,389 | Fair Value $ 1,776,963

Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ($) unless otherwise noted in Euros.

findings.detail: Cost currency was stored as UNIT_STANDARD_USD_GYIAAUPKRUCQGOAUDCFQTQ even though the source schedule presents the affected cost column in U.S. dollars.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error because the extracted cost_currency is a custom non-USD unit token, while the raw schedule shows the affected amortized cost values under dollar-sign columns and the schedule note states debt par amounts are denominated in U.S. Dollars unless otherwise noted in Euros. A targeted search found no euro exception in the filing source.
